hypothesis: Publishing the existing coarse one-block transform traversal as a pure-AVX2 callback for exact legacy-high GF8 K=R=T=64 with 64-byte shards will remove enough indirect butterfly dispatch to improve complete public encoding by at least five percent without regressing adjacent public shapes by more than two percent.

target.layout: native packed input and output slabs

scope.callback: A separately KAT-qualified Ops slot ran the coarse direct-input inverse LCH traversal and forward parity transform. The mature T=8 callback, generic ReedSolomonEncode implementation, wire profile, and public ABI remained unchanged.
scope.promotion_gate: Target lower 95 percent confidence bound at least 1.05; no exact-current neighboring regression greater than two percent; independent parity/correctness, zero-EVEX pure-AVX2 object, and bounded code growth.

final_text_attestation.normalization: Symbol addresses, branch targets, and RIP-relative displacements were normalized. The instruction stream matched; raw bytes differed only where the late callback shifted linked global addresses.

resource_policy.lower_parallelism_reason: Builds were capped at two jobs and 4 GiB after repeated host OOM incidents. Authoritative cache-sensitive timings were pinned to one physical core while its SMT sibling was checked for non-idle ticks.

correctness.backend_startup_kat: Passed an independent scalar reference for T=64 normal and one-coordinate-shortened input, unaligned input/output, vector tails including 65 bytes, guard bytes, and source immutability.
correctness.balanced_terminal_test: Passed ordinary and one-item-batch K=R in {32,64,128}, independent direct-generator parity, legacy parity where representable, unaligned packed slabs, sparse/detached fallback, byte neighbors 63/65/256, count neighbors, nulls, overlap, metadata overlap, and undersized/misaligned scratch.
correctness.candidate_focused_ctest: 7 of 7 passed: leopard2_backend_ops, leopard2_balanced_b64_terminal, leopard2_balanced_b64_terminal_production, leopard2_direct_encode, leopard2_auto_encode_backend, leopard2_api, and leopard2_public_api_contract.
correctness.zero_evex_check: The frozen pure-AVX2 object disassembly contained no zmm registers, ymm16-ymm31 registers, or mask-register operands.
correctness.sanitizers: Not run for the final layout candidate because the mandatory exact-current neighbor performance kill criterion fired before promotion qualification.

protocol.affinity: CPU 7; sibling CPU 23 required zero non-idle ticks or the invocation was retried
protocol.binary_integrity: Every executable was copied to a lane-owned read-only artifact directory and SHA-256 verified before and after timing.

measurement.ratio_definition: reference median time divided by candidate median time; values above one favor the candidate

attempts.integration: Published a side-switching pure-AVX2 callback through the mature primary one-block Ops slot.
attempts.result: Rejected structurally because the extra primary-slot wrapper perturbed the established nanosecond-scale T=8 route. The follow-up shim screen quantified a 4.91 percent T=8 slowdown while T=64 improved 11.74 percent.

attempts.integration: Added a separate T=64 Ops slot so the T=8 pointer and side mask stayed unchanged, but selected it inside the generic encoder.
attempts.result: Rejected: both non-target neighbors exceeded the two percent regression gate.

attempts.integration: Moved selection to ExecuteTransformEncodePass and put the callback and wrapper in a late dedicated text section. The mature ReedSolomonEncode executable region was restored byte-for-byte against its same-source control.
attempts.result: Rejected: K=16 was 8.3 percent slower and K=63 was 2.1 percent slower despite restoring the mature encoder bytes.

attempts.integration: Rebased onto 068659e and reused the already-promoted balanced-B64 public terminal. A separate callback was selected only after its aggregate packed-layout proof.
attempts.result: Rejected: same-source isolation passed, but the integration changed public executable layout and K=16 was 6.2 percent slower than exact current 068659e.

attempts.integration: The final permitted attempt gave the late wrapper the exact generic call signature, restoring K=16 hot-symbol addresses, sizes, and normalized instruction streams to exact current 068659e.
attempts.result: Rejected: the target improved 12.7 percent, but K=16 remained 2.9 percent slower by time ratio and failed the mandatory two percent neighboring-regression gate. K=63 was 2.0 percent slower at the median and its confidence interval crossed the two percent boundary.

invalid_tooling_attempt.failure: The first objcopy --dump-section command omitted a disposable output object. Because the frozen executable was read-only, objcopy attempted an in-place rewrite and exited nonzero before any timing began.
invalid_tooling_attempt.disposition: No performance conclusion was retained. The corrected command supplied a separate disposable output object, reverified frozen input hashes, and the authoritative campaign was restarted.

decision.reason: The coarse T=64 callback consistently saved about 11 to 14 percent in its exact target, proving that prepared in-translation-unit traversal is useful. Every integration that exposed it to the public codec, however, produced a credible neighboring regression above the two percent gate. The final layout-preserving attempt still slowed exact-current K=16/R=16 by about 2.9 percent.
decision.production_change: None. All T=64 callback, Ops-table, wrapper, selector, and route-test changes were removed. Only this negative result is retained.
decision.follow_up: Do not close leopard-79h.38.5.10.47.12: its required generated/fused T=16 candidate remains independent work. A future T=64 revisit should start from a generated per-size circuit that can replace, rather than add beside, an existing hot terminal and must repeat exact-current neighbors.

reproduction.benchmark_template: taskset -c 7 FROZEN_BINARY --profile high --field gf8 --backend avx2 --skip-legacy --retain-samples --attest-source --k K --r R --bytes 64 --loss 1 --batch 1 --reuse 8192 --iterations 21 --warmup 256 --threads 1 --seed 1 --json RESULT.json
